description.value: Firehouse Subs is a North American sandwich chain with a public-safety theme, known for hot subs piled with premium meats and toppings. This Burnaby location on Dawson Street offers takeout service and is part of a franchise network that donates a portion of sales to first-responder causes. For a touring cyclist needing a quick, filling meal stop, it provides a familiar menu with hearty sandwich options.
